title: Add tests for passFlakeInputs option
description: Add option existence test to module-config-tests.nix and optionally create behavior tests with fixtures.

title: Implement semantic versioning for nixDir
description: Add automated semantic versioning using git-cliff and Nix scripts. Multi-branch model: main→v1.x.y, v3→v3.x.y, etc. Consumers use branch for latest (github:user/nixDir/v3) or tag for pinned (github:user/nixDir/v3.2.1).

title: Add passFlakeInputs option to nixDir
description: Add a global option nixDir.passFlakeInputs that makes all files in the main nix/ directory receive flake inputs as the first parameter (like with-inputs/ behavior). This simplifies setup for projects that don't need portability.

title: Update documentation for passFlakeInputs
description: Update README.md and docs/with-inputs.md with Global Inputs Mode section and when-to-use guidance.

title: Update flake-level import functions for passFlakeInputs
description: Modify addNixOSModules, addNixOSConfigurations, addNixDarwinModules, addNixDarwinConfigurations, addHomeManagerModules, addDevenvModules to conditionally use WithInputs variants.

title: Add passFlakeInputs option definition
description: Add the passFlakeInputs option to default.nix options block with boolean type, default false, and descriptive documentation.

title: Update perSystem import functions for passFlakeInputs
description: Modify addPackages and addDevShellsAndDevenvs to conditionally use WithInputs variants based on cfg.passFlakeInputs.
